diagnostic_evidence.quote: in which case positive-definiteness is lost due to the existence of (non-zero) constant functions in $\harmSpace$

issues.failure_explanation: w = u^e - u^p_j lies only in H^1_D(omega*_j); it equals u^e on the interior boundary. For div b = 0, integrating by parts gives B_{omega*}(w,w) = ||w||_a^2 - (1/2)∫_{∂omega*∩Ω} w^2 b·n + (1/2)∫_{Γ_O∩∂omega*} w^2 b·n. The interior-boundary term has no sign, so the first inequality (coercivity) is unsupported. The continuity bound in the a-seminorm also fails on H^1_D(omega*). For an interior subdomain, a constant w has ||w||_a = 0, yet B_{omega*}(w,u^e) = -c∫_{∂omega*∖Γ_O} u^e b·n ≠ 0 in general. The cited Poincaré constants cannot apply to functions with no vanishing trace.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Bound u^p_j instead of the error. On H^1_{D,0}(omega*_j), B_{omega*} is coercive in ||.||_a when div b = 0, so ||u^p_j||_a^2 ≤ B(u^p_j,u^p_j) = B(u^e,u^p_j). After integrating the convection term by parts onto u^p_j and applying Poincaré to u^p_j, this is ≤ (1+C Pe)||u^e||_a||u^p_j||_a. Then use the triangle inequality, or ||I-π_j|| = ||π_j||.
issues.overall_effect: The uniform bound ||u^e-u^p_j||_{a,omega*_j} ≤ (1+C Pe)||u^e||_{a,omega*_j} is unproven. Hence eq:msgfem:global:coercive is unproven, and so is the existence of n_j in Theorem th:msgfem:iteration that relies on it.
issues.title: Local coercivity/continuity of B on the oversampling domain invoked where it fails
issues.why_classification: A short standard replacement argument recovers the same estimate, at most changing the constant 1 to 2. No claim or rate is lost.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: is the operator norm of the bilinear form $\bilWF{\cdot}{\cdot}{}$ up to coefficient-independent constants

issues.failure_explanation: In eq:msgfem:global, C_B is the global operator norm of B in the a-norm. Bounding ∫u b·∇v there requires the global Poincaré inequality, so C_B ~ 1 + C diam(Ω)||b||/a_min, a domain-scale Péclet number. The corollary replaces one factor by 1 + C max_j Pe_{H*_j}, which uses local Poincaré constants and is much smaller for many subdomains. This replacement does not follow from eq:msgfem:global as the proof asserts. The local factor would need a separate localized Céa-type argument, which is not given.

failure_location.quote: Estimate \cref{eq:msgfem:global:coercive} then follows from \cref{eq:msgfem:global} and the definition of $\colConst^*$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add a localized Céa argument. Use B(e,e) = B(e,z) with z = Σ χ_j w_j, integrate the convection term by parts onto z, and apply local Poincaré to χ_j w_j, which vanishes on ∂ω_j∩Ω. Alternatively, weaken the factor to the global Péclet number.
issues.overall_effect: The stated quantitative dependence (1+C Pe_H)^2 on the local Péclet number is unproven. Only a bound with a global-Péclet factor follows from the cited theorem. The qualitative conclusion used in th:msgfem:iteration survives with any fixed constant.
issues.title: Global constant C_B silently replaced by local oversampling Péclet number
issues.why_classification: Recovering the advertised local-Péclet dependence requires a contained new argument. The alternative weakens the stated constant materially, though the result remains comparable.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: we first define the local projection $\projB\colon \Hone \to \fwpTestSpaceLoc$ via

issues.failure_explanation: G maps into functions vanishing on Γ_D, since π_j(w) ∈ H^1_{D,0} and S_n ⊂ H^1_D. Hence the trace of e^(k) = u^(k) - u^e on Γ_D is invariant under the iteration. If u^(0) has a non-constant trace g ≠ u^e on Γ_D, then ||e^(k)||_a ≥ min{||w||_a : w|_{Γ_D} = g} > 0 for all k. This contradicts ||e^(k)||_a ≤ ϑ^k ||e^(0)||_a → 0. The operator bound 'for all v ∈ H^1' is not implied by eq:msgfem:iteration:1, which concerns solutions in H^1_D(Ω). The bound is also written in the local norm on ω*_j.

failure_location.quote: converges for any initial guess $\fwp^{(0)} \in \Hone$ strictly monotonically

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restrict to u^(0) with u^(0) - u^e ∈ H^1_D(Ω). State the operator bound ||(I-G)v||_{a,Ω} ≤ ϑ||v||_{a,Ω} for v ∈ H^1_D(Ω), using that the corollary bound is uniform in v.
issues.overall_effect: The contraction estimate eq:msgfem:iteration:2 is false for initial guesses with wrong Dirichlet data. It holds only for errors in H^1_D(Ω).
issues.title: Convergence claimed for arbitrary initial guess in H^1(Ω) although Dirichlet trace error is never corrected
issues.why_classification: This is a standard restriction of the initial-guess class plus a norm correction. The method, rate and main conclusion are unchanged.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: We choose the rotating velocity field

issues.failure_explanation: For the displayed field, ∂1 b1 = ∂2 b2 = -40(x1-0.5)(x2-0.5) - 1.5, so div b = -80(x1-0.5)(x2-0.5) - 3. This ranges over [-23, 17] and is positive near the corners (0,1) and (1,0), e.g. 17 at (0,1). Near the centre the field behaves like (20y - 1.5x, 20x - 1.5y), which is a saddle/strain flow, not a rotation. The prose description of the tested indefinite problem therefore contradicts the formula given.
